{{For|the similar quest on the {{Zone|Moonglade Marsh}}|Trial of Blue Flames}} {{Infobox/Location |location=[[Dark Thicket]] |x = -359 |y = 102 |z = -90 |requirements = '''A Helping Hand''' Quest |resources = Dark Oak Log }} The '''Trials of Fire''' is a location and challenge found in the {{zone|Dark Thicket}} of {{zone|The Park}}. The player must stand inside a campfire for {{Green|10}} seconds of increasing damage to earn and improve an [[Accessory]]. The '''Trials of Fire''' can be started by talking to {{NPCSprite|Ryan}}. If the player fails a trial, they do not lose {{c}} or potion effects. If the DPS is higher than the player's max {{stat|health}}, the player instantly fails. {{ZoneText|Compete in a &6Trial of Fire&f.}} == Trials == The {{Item|Campfire Initiate Badge|text=Campfire Badges}} heal varying amounts of {{Stat|hp}} per second while burning based on progression. In addition, all {{Legendary}} versions of the {{Item|Campfire Initiate Badge|text=Campfire Badge}} grant {{Stat|hp}} per second boost regardless of if the player is not on fire. {{:Trials of Fire/List}} === Upgrading [[Campfire Badge]] === {| class="wikitable" !Upgrade !Materials !Material Cost |- |Initiate → Adept |{{Item|Dark Oak Log|amount=160}} |{{Plainlist| *{{NPCSprite|Lumber Merchant}}: {{c|800}} *[[Bazaar]]: {{BZC|160 Dark Oak Log}}{{BazaarInfoIcon}} }} |- |Adept → Cultist |{{Item|Spruce Log|amount=1064}} |{{Plainlist| *{{NPCSprite|Lumber Merchant}}: {{c|5320}} (2 days, 1 with {{NPCSprite|Diaz}}) *[[Bazaar]]: {{BZC|1064 Spruce Log}}{{BazaarInfoIcon}} }} |- |Cultist → Scion |{{DRL| *100 Enchanted Acacia Log **16000 Acacia Log }} |{{Plainlist| *{{NPCSprite|Lumber Merchant}}: {{c|400k}} (25 days, 3 with {{NPCSprite|Diaz}}) *[[Bazaar]]: {{BZC|100 Enchanted Acacia Log}}{{BazaarInfoIcon}} }} |- |Scion → God |{{DRL| *1500 Enchanted Jungle Log **240000 Jungle Log }} |{{Plainlist| *{{NPCSprite|Lumber Merchant}}: {{c|6m}} (375 days, 38 with {{NPCSprite|Diaz}}) *[[Bazaar]]: {{BZC|1500 Enchanted Jungle Log}}{{BazaarInfoIcon}} }} |} === General Tips === The campfire deals both {{Stat|True Damage}} and {{stat|dmg}}. All defensive stats like {{Stat|defense}}, {{Stat|hp}} and {{Stat|td}} will help in the trial. Players must rely on [[Health]] and [[Healing]] items. Helpful items include: {{outdated|section=yes}} {| class="wikitable" !Icon !Item !Effect |- | {{Slot|Zombie's Heart}} || [[Zombie's Heart]] (helmet) || Gives +50 {{Stat|short=yes|HP}} and +30 {{stat|vitality}} |- | {{Slot|Crystallized Heart}} || [[Crystallized Heart]] (helmet) || Gives +50 {{Stat|short=yes|HP}} and +40 {{stat|vitality}}. |- | {{Slot|Revived Heart}} || [[Revived Heart]] (helmet) || Gives +100 {{Stat|short=yes|HP}} and +50 {{stat|vitality}}. |- | {{Slot|Reaper Mask}} || [[Reaper Mask]] (helmet) || Gives +150 {{Stat|short=yes|HP}} and +60 {{stat|vitality}}. |- | {{Slot|Healing Talisman}}{{Slot|Healing Ring}} || [[Healing Talisman]] ([[Healing Ring|Ring]]) || Gives +2/+4 {{stat|vitality}}. |- | {{Slot|Survivor Cube}} || [[Survivor Cube]] || Gives +3 {{stat|vitality}}. |- | {{Slot|Radiant Power Orb}}{{Slot|Mana Flux Power Orb}}{{Slot|Overflux Power Orb}}{{Slot|Plasmaflux Power Orb}} || [[Power Orbs]] || Heals 30/40/50/60 {{stat|short=yes|hp}} per second and gain 25/50/100/125 {{stat|health regen}} |- | {{Slot|Wand of Healing}} || [[Wand of Healing]] (and upgraded forms) || Heal 60 {{Stat|short=yes|health}}/s (120 max upgrade) for 5s (7 max upgrade). |- | {{Slot|Golden Apple}}{{Slot|Enchanted Golden Apple}} || [[Golden Apple]] or
[[Enchanted Golden Apple]] || Provides a small boost to {{Stat|Absorption}}. |- | {{Slot|Healing Potion}} || [[Healing Potion]]s || Instant Healing - Tier VIII gives 500 {{Stat|short=yes|HP}}. |- | {{Slot|Regeneration Potion}} || [[Regeneration Potion]]s || Tier VIII heals 50 {{Stat|short=yes|HP}} / sec. |- | {{Slot|True Resistance Potion}} || [[True Resistance Potion]] || Tier IV gives +20 {{Stat|true defense}}. |- | {{Slot|Absorption Potion}} || [[Absorption Potion]] || Gives a large amount of {{Stat|Absorption}} (bonus {{Stat|HP}}). |- | {{Slot|Enchanted Book (True Protection I)}} || {{EnchantmentsLink|True Protection}} || Grants +5 {{Stat|true defense}}. |- | {{Slot|Enchanted Book (Respite I)}} || {{EnchantmentsLink|Respite}} | Increases natural regeneration by 5% per level while out of combat, allowing for a doubling of natural regeneration if all armor is enchanted with Respite. |- | {{Slot|Zombie Sword}} || [[Zombie Sword]] || Heals the user for 320 {{Stat|short=yes|health}} and other players within {{Green|7}} blocks for 64 {{Stat|short=yes|health}}. |- | {{Slot|Ornate Zombie Sword}} || [[Ornate Zombie Sword]] || Heal the user for 420 {{Stat|short=yes|hp}} and other players within {{Green|7}} blocks for 84 {{Stat|short=yes|hp}}. |- | {{Slot|Florid Zombie Sword}} || [[Florid Zombie Sword]] || Heal the user for 500 {{Stat|short=yes|hp}} and other players within {{Green|7}} blocks for 100 {{Stat|short=yes|hp}}. |- | {{Slot|Gloomlock Grimoire}} || [[Gloomlock Grimoire]] ||Heal the user for 1000 {{stat|short=yes|HP}} |- | {{Slot|Wolf Pet}} ||[[Wolf Pet]] |The base stats increase {{Stat|True Defense}} . |- |- |{{Slot|Blue Whale Pet}} ||[[Blue Whale Pet]] |While using regeneration and healing [[Potions]], this pet can increase the healing effect. Base stats increases {{Stat|HP}} and a Legendary Blue Whale pet also gives an added percent of {{Stat|short=yes|hp}}. |- |{{Slot|Rock Pet}} || [[Rock Pet]] |While its {{Stat|Defense}} doesn't do much, it gives at least a tiny bit of {{Stat|True Defense}} if that's the only option. |} === Trial XXX Recommendations === {{outdated|section=yes}} To survive up to the '''Trials of Fire''' XXX, players must have at least {{hp|352800}} or the equivalent true damage protection. This list assumes that their mana lasts for the duration of the campfire test. There are two commonly used methods to overcome the later trials, which are listed below. ==== Method 1 ==== * Armor: [[Mastiff Armor]] with the [[Precursor Gear|Ancient]] reforge. ** Optionally, it is possible to put {{EnchantmentsLink|Fire Protection|tier=5}} on all pieces and {{EnchantmentsLink|True Protection|tier=1}} on the chestplate. * Accessory Power: {{AccessoryPowerLink|Commando}}, {{AccessoryPowerLink|Shaded}}, or {{AccessoryPowerLink|Silky}} are the best accessory powers when using [[Mastiff Armor]]. It is important to have a good amount of [[Accessories]] to maximize the effect of the accessory powers. * Pets: ** A high-level [[Enderman Pet]] of any rarity for {{Stat|cd}}. ** An [[Ender Dragon Pet]], as it's third ability increases both {{Stat|cd}} and {{Stat|Health}}. ** {{Legendary}} [[Blue Whale Pet]] can also be used due to its high bonus to {{Stat|Health}}. ** Maxed level of [[Sheep Pet]]'s second ability, '''{{Gold|Overheal}}''', could also add 10% of {{Stat|Health}}. ** Another good pet is the [[Mithril Golem Pet]], giving the largest amount of {{Stat|True Defense}}. ** Optional Pet Item: [[Iron Claws]] * Weapons: **[[Terminator]] with the {{ReforgingLink|Rapid}} reforge and {{EnchantmentsLink|Overload V}} is the best option for critical damage on a weapon, granting a total of 365 {{Stat|cd}}. ** If the player wishes to use a more affordable weapon, a [[Livid Dagger]] with {{EnchantmentsLink|Critical}} enchantment and [[Suspicious Vial|Suspicious]] reforge or a [[Juju Shortbow]] with {{ReforgingLink|Rapid}} reforge are recommended. * Potion effects especially: Regeneration; Critical; True Defense and Spirit (best option is to use [[God Potion]]). ==== Method 2 ==== * Items: [[Wither Cloak Sword]] with {{EnchantmentsLink|Ultimate Wise V}}, and [[Mastiff Armor]]. ** [[Stamina Potion|Stamina]] and [[Mana Potion]]s with a [[Bitter Ice Tea]] base, as well as [[Mana|Overflow Mana]]. ** A level 100 [[Jerry Pet]] with a [[Minos Relic]] can be helpful to increase the effects of the Mana potion. ** Optionally, a [[Gloomlock Grimoire]] can be used in the process. * Method: Use the Wither Cloak Sword to tank the majority of the damage. If the effect expires, switch to Gloomlock Grimoire and spam between life tap and Extreme Measures. If you still are having trouble try asking someone else to cast the Lesser Orb of Healing and place a Power Orb. Mastiff Armor is still needed to overcome one second of the damage dealt ({{HP|35280}}). == NPCs == {{Location NPCs}} == Trivia == *The '''Trial of Fire'''{{'}}s [[mcw:Campfire|Campfire]] checks slightly higher for the player's [[mcw:hitbox|hitbox]] than the [[Trial of Blue Flames]]' [[mcw:Soul Campfire|Soul Campfire]]. ==See Also== *[[Trial of Blue Flames]] == History == {{History table |ahn= {{History|2025/June 5|Added '''Trials of Fire''' as a location.}} {{History|2026/Jun 10|'''Trial of Fire''' now deals {{stat|dmg|80%}} and {{stat|tdmg|20%}} instead of {{stat|tdmg|100%}}.|Rescaled damage values.}} |beta= {{History|0.7.4|Added '''Trials of Fire'''.}} {{History|0.23|Added '''Trials of Fire''' as a location.}} {{History|2026/Jul 22|'''Trial of Fire''' now deals {{stat|dmg|80%}} and {{stat|tdmg|20%}} instead of {{stat|tdmg|100%}}.|Rescaled damage values.}} }} [[Category:Quests]] [[Category:0.7.4]] [[Category:Park]]
